name: Minnolith
look: a round pale-blue prehistoric fish with a white face, big dark eyes, brown ear-like fins and a fan of tail fins
entry: A tiny fish that swam in rivers long before any other Pokémon. Its round body is wrapped in thin plates of armour, and schools of them darted through the shallows like scattered pebbles.
how: Revive a Minnow Fossil at a Restoration Tank. Minnow Fossils are found by brushing the suspicious gravel of fossil beds on the bottoms of rivers and swamps.
